TunnelPreferences.description: Personal settings of every SSH tunnel on this computer.

port_min.description:
Local ports for tunnels are taken from `port_min` to `port_max` (both included), for
a firewall that only allows some; any free port when absent. Both or neither.

UserMasking.description: The user's own masking patterns, for every connection (ADR-051).

always.description:
Columns to mask, as a connection's `[masking] always` patterns. A personal
connection's `never` may leave one of them visible; a repository connection's cannot.

description: Personal configuration: `<user config>/spelaiondb/user.toml`. Never goes to git.

masking.description: Columns masked on every connection on this computer (ADR-051).
